rationale: Coverage thresholds are met: 8/8 P0 oracle items are FULL and all 20 ACF-relevant Jest/supertest tests passed. The final ACF-1 gate is FAIL because the evidence is not independently approved under AD-1, the HTTP allow/deny mapping remains a provisional Access Control assumption pending User Management contract answer 3, and the production module is dormant: AppModule does not import AccessControlModule, so GET /users/:id remains on the interim allow-all adapter.
